description.text: Entrance Examinations 1. HSK 6 or higher 2.comprehension examinations (written) 3. interview Teaching materials: 150 to 300 CNY/semester

duration.text: The Condensed State Physics at Sichuan University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3472 USD/per year ￥ 25000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 6. Letters of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents

requirements.text: 1.Under 40 years old 2.With degree equivalent to a bachelor in China, or just finished a bachelor from a Chinese university, good grades, reference letters from two professors
